paragraphs.en: Abstract Recent advances in large language models and agentic workflows offer a new paradigm to early-stage structural design translating design intent into structural models. Although text-to-3D approaches have demonstrated that natural language can be used to produce visual, mesh-based geometric models, structural design requires domain-specific geometric arrangements and semantically rich data types. This paper introduces a proof-of-concept workflow for prompt-to-structure generation using an AI agent connected to a COMPAS-based structural modelling API through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Through controlled modelling operations, the agent creates and modifies a graph-based structural data model composed of explicit building elements. The resulting artifacts can be inspected, modified, serialised, and further connected to downstream AEC workflows. The approach is demonstrated through selected prompt-to-structure examples and by progressive and editable design sequences that resemble typical iterative structural design workflows. The results are preliminary, but demonstrate the possibility of combining natural language, agentic workflows, and domain-specific structural data structures as a first step toward AI-assisted structural co-design.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要 大语言模型与智能体工作流的最新进展为早期结构设计提供了一种新范式，可将设计意图转化为结构模型。 尽管文本生成三维（text-to-3D）方法已经证明自然语言可以用来生成基于网格的视觉几何模型，但结构设计需要领域特定的几何布置和语义丰富的数据类型。 本文介绍了一个概念验证工作流，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器将一个智能体连接到基于 COMPAS 的结构建模 API，实现从提示词到结构的生成。 智能体通过受控的建模操作，创建并修改一个由显式建筑构件组成的基于图的结构数据模型。 所生成的产物可以被检查、修改、序列化，并进一步连接到下游的建筑、工程与施工（AEC）工作流。 该方法通过精选的从提示词到结构的示例，以及类似典型迭代式结构设计工作流的渐进式、可编辑的设计序列加以演示。 结果尚属初步，但展示了将自然语言、智能体工作流与领域特定结构数据结构相结合的可能性，作为迈向人工智能辅助结构协同设计的第一步。

paragraphs.en: Structural design is not only a process of satisfying performance constraints but also a creative discipline in which form, force, materials, and construction logic are negotiated together. Torroja emphasized the role of intuition and imagination in the conception of structural form [ 26 ] , while Billington described structural art as the integration of efficiency, economy, and elegance [ 4 ] . From this perspective, early-stage structural design cannot be reduced to the automatic generation of final solutions, but rather is an iterative process in which designers progressively develop their final result.
paragraphs.zh: 结构设计不仅是满足性能约束的过程，更是一门创造性的学科，其中形态、力、材料与建造逻辑共同协商。 Torroja 强调了直觉与想象力在结构形态构思中的作用 [ 26 ] ，而 Billington 则将结构艺术描述为效率、经济性与优雅的整合 [ 4 ] 。 从这一视角来看，早期结构设计不能被简化为最终方案的自动生成，而是一个设计者逐步发展其最终结果的迭代过程。

paragraphs.en: Previous work on computational structural design and engineering education has focused on making this exploration more creative and interactive by introducing geometry-based approaches to structural understanding [ 25 , 1 , 27 , 17 ] , developing computational tools to explore families of structural forms [ 21 , 12 , 24 ] and performing topology exploration rather than just looking for a single optimal design [ 19 , 22 , 6 ] . Further developing this line of work, text-enhanced structural design systems have introduced language as an interface for form-finding and conceptual exploration [ 9 ] , including graph- and transformer-based algorithms [ 5 ] . In this context, recent developments in large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows offer a new paradigm to early-stage structural design where AI systems can better understand design intent, create and edit 3D artifacts towards a co-design process.
paragraphs.zh: 以往在计算结构设计与工程教育方面的工作，主要通过引入基于几何的结构理解方法[25, 1, 27, 17]、开发用于探索结构形式族系的计算工具[21, 12, 24]，以及进行拓扑探索而非仅仅寻找单一最优设计[19, 22, 6]，来使这种探索更具创造性和交互性。 为了进一步推进这一方向的工作，文本增强的结构设计系统引入了语言作为找形与概念探索的交互界面[9]，其中包括基于图和基于Transformer的算法[5]。 在此背景下，大语言模型（LLM）与智能体工作流的最新进展为早期结构设计提供了一种新范式，使AI系统能够更好地理解设计意图、创建和编辑三维作品，从而实现协同设计过程。

paragraphs.en: Recent text-to-3D systems have made substantial progress in generating visual 3D assets represented as neural fields, meshes, or learned 3D latents [ 23 , 15 , 29 ] . More recent work in LLM-assisted modelling has begun to explore the generation of 3D CAD geometries and 2D FEA analysis from written scripts [ 7 , 16 , 13 , 11 , 14 ] . These developments suggest that language can become an increasingly powerful interface for geometry generation. However, structural design requires more than a generic mesh-based structural geometry as they must contain semantically rich objects, including joints, frames and areas, connectivity information, and domain-specific metadata.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的文本生成3D系统在生成以神经场、网格或学习到的3D潜在表示的视觉3D资产方面已取得重大进展 [ 23 , 15 , 29 ] 。 更近期的LLM辅助建模工作已开始探索从文字脚本生成3D CAD几何体和2D有限元分析 [ 7 , 16 , 13 , 11 , 14 ] 。 这些进展表明，语言可以成为日益强大的几何生成接口。 然而，结构设计所需要的不仅仅是通用的基于网格的结构几何体，因为它们必须包含语义丰富的对象，包括节点、框架和面域、连接信息以及领域特定的元数据。

paragraphs.en: Building on the need to develop interactive design processes and on the emerging capabilities and potential of LLMs and agentic systems, this work proposes a workflow that connects a language-model agent to a domain-specific structural modelling API through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. The agent interprets natural-language design intent and requests modelling actions that generate or edit a COMPAS-based graph data structure [ 28 ] that contains explicit structural objects such as joints, frames, slabs, walls, grids and levels. This object-based representation allows the generated artifact to be inspected, modified, serialized, and further connected to downstream AEC workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 基于开发交互式设计流程的需求，以及大语言模型（LLM）和智能体系统新出现的能力与潜力，本工作提出了一种工作流，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器将语言模型智能体连接到特定领域的结构建模 API。 该智能体解释自然语言表达的设计意图，并请求建模操作，以生成或编辑基于 COMPAS 的图数据结构 [ 28 ]，其中包含诸如节点、框架、楼板、墙体、轴网和标高等显式结构对象。 这种基于对象的表示方式使得生成的成果可以被检查、修改、序列化，并进一步连接到下游的建筑、工程与施工（AEC）工作流中。

paragraphs.en: The contribution of this paper is a proof-of-concept workflow for early-stage structural modelling with language agents. It introduces a COMPAS-based structural data structure for representing generated buildings as editable graph-based artifacts, and it demonstrates the approach through selected prompt-generated examples, a language-based editing sequence, and a progressive modelling example. By generating explicit structural data that can be inspected, modified, and connected to downstream workflows, this work paves the way to further research on interactive natural-language-based interfaces for structural design.
paragraphs.zh: 本文的贡献是一个概念验证工作流，用于在结构建模早期阶段使用语言智能体。 该工作引入了一种基于 COMPAS 的结构数据结构，将生成的建筑表示为可编辑的基于图元的制品，并通过若干提示词生成的示例、一个基于语言的编辑序列以及一个渐进式建模示例展示了该方法。 通过生成可被检视、修改并连接到下游工作流的显式结构数据，这项工作为进一步研究面向结构设计的交互式自然语言界面铺平了道路。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 summarizes the proposed workflow. A designer provides a natural-language prompt describing a desired structural model or modification. A specialised AI agent interprets this request and communicates with a structural modelling environment through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. The server acts as an interface between natural-language reasoning and deterministic modelling actions. These actions generate or modify a 3D structural model. The resulting model can then be reviewed and further adjusted using follow-up instructions. The individual components of this workflow are detailed below.
paragraphs.zh: 图1总结了所提出的工作流程。 设计者提供一个自然语言提示词，描述所需的结构模型或修改。 一个专门的智能体解释该请求，并通过模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器与结构建模环境进行通信。 该服务器充当自然语言推理与确定性建模操作之间的接口。 这些操作生成或修改三维结构模型。 所得到的模型随后可以通过后续指令进行审查和进一步调整。 该工作流程的各个组成部分将在下文详细说明。

paragraphs.en: The central component of the workflow is the domain-specific data structure. The generated artifact is represented as a COMPAS [ 28 ] graph-based model which defines the main elements of the system, their connectivity and key meta-data associated with them. These elements are semantically rich and directly relate to the definitions used in structural engineering practice.
paragraphs.zh: 工作流程的核心组件是领域特定的数据结构。 生成的产物被表示为一个 COMPAS [ 28 ] 基于图（graph）的模型，该模型定义了系统的主要元素、它们的连接关系以及与它们关联的关键元数据。 这些元素具有丰富的语义，并直接对应于结构工程实践中使用的定义。

paragraphs.en: The structural API exposes a small set of Python classes corresponding to common building-scale structural elements and enable operations on them such as additions, deletions, copy, translations, and rotations. The API enables the creation of Joints() as points in the 3D space, Frame() connecting two joints, and Area() elements connecting 3 or more points. The Frame() object is further specialised into Beam() , Column() and Brace() to represent horizontal, vertical, and inclined elements in the structure. The Area() object is further specialised in Wall() and Slab() elements. Classes for storing metadata assigned to these elements are also present in the API, including Material() and Section() . Geometry constructors are also present and allow for the definition of Grid() and Level() as well as to operate geometrically on these entities.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化 API 暴露了一小组 Python 类，对应常见的建筑尺度结构构件，并支持对它们进行添加、删除、复制、平移和旋转等操作。 该 API 支持创建作为三维空间中的点的 Joints()、连接两个节点的 Frame()，以及连接 3 个或更多点的 Area() 构件。 Frame() 对象进一步细化为 Beam()、Column() 和 Brace()，用以表示结构中的水平、竖直和倾斜构件。 Area() 对象进一步细化为 Wall() 和 Slab() 构件。 API 中还包含用于存储分配给这些构件的元数据的类，包括 Material() 和 Section()。 API 中还提供几何构造器，可用于定义 Grid() 和 Level()，并对这些实体进行几何操作。

sents.en: The structural API exposes a small set of Python classes corresponding to common building-scale structural elements and enable operations on them such as additions, deletions, copy, translations, and rotations.
sents.zh: 结构化 API 暴露了一小组 Python 类，对应常见的建筑尺度结构构件，并支持对它们进行添加、删除、复制、平移和旋转等操作。

sents.en: The API enables the creation of Joints() as points in the 3D space, Frame() connecting two joints, and Area() elements connecting 3 or more points.
sents.zh: 该 API 支持创建作为三维空间中的点的 Joints()、连接两个节点的 Frame()，以及连接 3 个或更多点的 Area() 构件。

sents.en: The Frame() object is further specialised into Beam() , Column() and Brace() to represent horizontal, vertical, and inclined elements in the structure.
sents.zh: Frame() 对象进一步细化为 Beam()、Column() 和 Brace()，用以表示结构中的水平、竖直和倾斜构件。

sents.en: The Area() object is further specialised in Wall() and Slab() elements.
sents.zh: Area() 对象进一步细化为 Wall() 和 Slab() 构件。

sents.en: Classes for storing metadata assigned to these elements are also present in the API, including Material() and Section() .
sents.zh: API 中还包含用于存储分配给这些构件的元数据的类，包括 Material() 和 Section()。

sents.en: Geometry constructors are also present and allow for the definition of Grid() and Level() as well as to operate geometrically on these entities.
sents.zh: API 中还提供几何构造器，可用于定义 Grid() 和 Level()，并对这些实体进行几何操作。

paragraphs.en: These objects are assembled in a Structure() class, which stores a graph-based representation of the structural model that enables direct access to adjacent entities. In this graph, the nodes correspond to the joints, whereas the frame and area elements encode relationships among those nodes. The API facilitates common operations in building-scale modelling, including creating and modifying regular grids, adding and replicating stories, and copying and dragging objects. This API is exposed to the AI agent through an MCP server, so the operations are executed through function calls as defined below.
paragraphs.zh: 这些对象被组装在一个 Structure() 类中，该类存储结构模型的基于图的表示，可直接访问相邻实体。 在该图中，节点对应于节点（joints），而框架和面元素则编码这些节点之间的关系。 该 API 支持建筑尺度建模中的常见操作，包括创建和修改规则网格、添加和复制楼层，以及复制和拖拽对象。 该 API 通过一个 MCP 服务器暴露给智能体，因此相关操作通过下文定义的函数调用来执行。

sents.en: These objects are assembled in a Structure() class, which stores a graph-based representation of the structural model that enables direct access to adjacent entities.
sents.zh: 这些对象被组装在一个 Structure() 类中，该类存储结构模型的基于图的表示，可直接访问相邻实体。

sents.en: In this graph, the nodes correspond to the joints, whereas the frame and area elements encode relationships among those nodes.
sents.zh: 在该图中，节点对应于节点（joints），而框架和面元素则编码这些节点之间的关系。

sents.en: The API facilitates common operations in building-scale modelling, including creating and modifying regular grids, adding and replicating stories, and copying and dragging objects.
sents.zh: 该 API 支持建筑尺度建模中的常见操作，包括创建和修改规则网格、添加和复制楼层，以及复制和拖拽对象。

sents.en: This API is exposed to the AI agent through an MCP server, so the operations are executed through function calls as defined below.
sents.zh: 该 API 通过一个 MCP 服务器暴露给智能体，因此相关操作通过下文定义的函数调用来执行。

paragraphs.en: Recently, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) was introduced [ 2 ] as an open protocol for connecting AI assistants to external tools, data sources, and services. In AEC, recent work has begun to use MCP-like interfaces to allow LLMs to query, generate, and modify IFC or BIM models [ 20 , 10 ] and generate OpenSees and ETABS structural analysis models [ 3 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近期，模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，MCP）被提出 [ 2 ]，作为连接 AI 助手与外部工具、数据源和服务的开放协议。 在 AEC 领域，近期已有工作开始使用类 MCP 接口，使大语言模型能够查询、生成和修改 IFC 或 BIM 模型 [ 20 , 10 ]，并生成 OpenSees 和 ETABS 结构分析模型 [ 3 ]。

sents.en: Recently, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) was introduced [ 2 ] as an open protocol for connecting AI assistants to external tools, data sources, and services.
sents.zh: 近期，模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，MCP）被提出 [ 2 ]，作为连接 AI 助手与外部工具、数据源和服务的开放协议。

sents.en: In AEC, recent work has begun to use MCP-like interfaces to allow LLMs to query, generate, and modify IFC or BIM models [ 20 , 10 ] and generate OpenSees and ETABS structural analysis models [ 3 ] .
sents.zh: 在 AEC 领域，近期已有工作开始使用类 MCP 接口，使大语言模型能够查询、生成和修改 IFC 或 BIM 模型 [ 20 , 10 ]，并生成 OpenSees 和 ETABS 结构分析模型 [ 3 ]。

paragraphs.en: In the present work, an MCP server is created to expose the COMPAS-based structural modelling API to the agent. When triggered by the AI agent, the MCP functions execute deterministic operations and return the updated state of the model. These controlled actions populate and modify a graph-based structural data structure. As a result, an explicit 3D structural artifact is produced that can then be inspected visually and modified through follow-up instructions. The AI agent is pre-configured to use the MCP definitions to build the structural artifacts and relies on Google Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 8 ] for reasoning on the user input.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们创建了一个 MCP 服务器，将基于 COMPAS 的结构建模 API 暴露给智能体。 当被 AI 智能体触发时，MCP 函数执行确定性操作并返回模型的更新状态。 这些受控操作填充并修改基于图的结构数据结构。 由此生成一个显式的三维结构产物，可供可视化检查并通过后续指令进行修改。 AI 智能体被预先配置为使用 MCP 定义来构建结构产物，并依靠 Google Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 8 ] 对用户输入进行推理。

sents.en: In the present work, an MCP server is created to expose the COMPAS-based structural modelling API to the agent.
sents.zh: 在本工作中，我们创建了一个 MCP 服务器，将基于 COMPAS 的结构建模 API 暴露给智能体。

sents.en: When triggered by the AI agent, the MCP functions execute deterministic operations and return the updated state of the model.
sents.zh: 当被 AI 智能体触发时，MCP 函数执行确定性操作并返回模型的更新状态。

sents.en: These controlled actions populate and modify a graph-based structural data structure.
sents.zh: 这些受控操作填充并修改基于图的结构数据结构。

sents.en: As a result, an explicit 3D structural artifact is produced that can then be inspected visually and modified through follow-up instructions.
sents.zh: 由此生成一个显式的三维结构产物，可供可视化检查并通过后续指令进行修改。

sents.en: The AI agent is pre-configured to use the MCP definitions to build the structural artifacts and relies on Google Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 8 ] for reasoning on the user input.
sents.zh: AI 智能体被预先配置为使用 MCP 定义来构建结构产物，并依靠 Google Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 8 ] 对用户输入进行推理。

paragraphs.en: The generated structures are stored as explicit COMPAS objects whose data can be serialised and stored as a structured JSON file. Based on the COMPAS ecosystem interoperability features, the geometric data underlying the model can be imported and exported to common geometry formats. The development of different connectors to common AEC software is planned as future work such that the generated models could be directly transformed into AEC software models typically used in structural practice.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的结构以显式的 COMPAS 对象形式存储，其数据可以序列化并保存为结构化的 JSON 文件。 基于 COMPAS 生态系统的互操作性特性，模型底层的几何数据可以导入和导出为常见的几何格式。 开发面向常见 AEC 软件的不同连接器已计划作为未来工作，以便生成的模型可以直接转换为结构工程实践中通常使用的 AEC 软件模型。

sents.en: The generated structures are stored as explicit COMPAS objects whose data can be serialised and stored as a structured JSON file.
sents.zh: 生成的结构以显式的 COMPAS 对象形式存储，其数据可以序列化并保存为结构化的 JSON 文件。

sents.en: Based on the COMPAS ecosystem interoperability features, the geometric data underlying the model can be imported and exported to common geometry formats.
sents.zh: 基于 COMPAS 生态系统的互操作性特性，模型底层的几何数据可以导入和导出为常见的几何格式。

sents.en: The development of different connectors to common AEC software is planned as future work such that the generated models could be directly transformed into AEC software models typically used in structural practice.
sents.zh: 开发面向常见 AEC 软件的不同连接器已计划作为未来工作，以便生成的模型可以直接转换为结构工程实践中通常使用的 AEC 软件模型。

paragraphs.en: The next section demonstrates the use of the presented workflow to generate, edit, and progressively design complex structural building artifacts that can serve engineers and architects working on early-stage structural design.
paragraphs.zh: 下一节将演示如何使用所提出的工作流来生成、编辑并逐步设计复杂的结构建筑构件，这些构件可服务于从事早期结构设计的工程师和建筑师。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 presents five selected examples of prompt-generated structural models that show the potential of the current workflow to generate a range of structural building models. The examples move from simple to more complex artifacts. P01 demonstrates the basic creation of columns, beams, and slabs from span and height information. P02 introduces a circular plan, repeated perimeter columns, and a core wall. P03 uses a notional grid and removes bays to form an L-shaped plan. P04 extends the task to a terraced multi-story structure with different floor extents across levels. P05 introduces geometric rotating stories along the height of the building. Together, these examples suggest that the agent can generate models that mix different structural arrangements and geometric operations. Furthermore, the agent can handle domain-specific vocabulary used to describe building-scale models.
paragraphs.zh: 图2展示了五个由提示词生成的结构模型示例，体现了当前工作流生成一系列结构建筑模型的潜力。 这些示例从简单到复杂逐步递进。 P01展示了根据跨度和高度信息创建柱、梁和楼板的基本过程。 P02引入了圆形平面、重复的周边柱以及核心筒墙。 P03使用名义网格并通过移除部分区格形成L形平面。 P04将任务扩展为阶梯式多层结构，各楼层的平面范围有所不同。 P05沿建筑高度引入了几何上逐层旋转的楼层。 总体而言，这些示例表明智能体能够生成混合不同结构布置与几何操作的模型。 此外，智能体还能够处理用于描述建筑尺度模型的领域特定术语。

sents.zh: 图2展示了五个由提示词生成的结构模型示例，体现了当前工作流生成一系列结构建筑模型的潜力。

sents.zh: 这些示例从简单到复杂逐步递进。

sents.zh: P01展示了根据跨度和高度信息创建柱、梁和楼板的基本过程。

sents.zh: 总体而言，这些示例表明智能体能够生成混合不同结构布置与几何操作的模型。

sents.en: Furthermore, the agent can handle domain-specific vocabulary used to describe building-scale models.
sents.zh: 此外，智能体还能够处理用于描述建筑尺度模型的领域特定术语。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 illustrates how a generated artifact can be modified through follow-up language instructions. Starting from the circular tower in P02, the user asks for an extension to the first three floors. The AI agent first queries about the current state of the model, reasons about the required addition or modification, and the maps the MCP tools that need to be called to achieve it. For this example, the agent responds to the user prompt by adding beams and columns creating the extension as requested. The user then follows up with another modification, requesting the addition of slabs on the newly created floors. The updated version adds the slab elements to the designated floors.
paragraphs.zh: 图3展示了如何通过后续的语言指令修改已生成的产物。 从P02中的圆形塔开始，用户要求对前三层进行扩建。 AI智能体首先查询模型的当前状态，对所需的增加或修改进行推理，然后映射需要调用的MCP工具来实现该目标。 在此示例中，智能体通过添加梁和柱来创建所请求的扩建部分，从而响应用户的提示。 用户随后进行另一项修改，要求在新建的楼层上添加楼板。 更新后的版本在指定楼层添加了楼板构件。

sents.en: Figure 3 illustrates how a generated artifact can be modified through follow-up language instructions.
sents.zh: 图3展示了如何通过后续的语言指令修改已生成的产物。

sents.en: Starting from the circular tower in P02, the user asks for an extension to the first three floors.
sents.zh: 从P02中的圆形塔开始，用户要求对前三层进行扩建。

sents.en: The AI agent first queries about the current state of the model, reasons about the required addition or modification, and the maps the MCP tools that need to be called to achieve it.

sents.en: For this example, the agent responds to the user prompt by adding beams and columns creating the extension as requested.
sents.zh: 在此示例中，智能体通过添加梁和柱来创建所请求的扩建部分，从而响应用户的提示。

sents.en: The user then follows up with another modification, requesting the addition of slabs on the newly created floors.
sents.zh: 用户随后进行另一项修改，要求在新建的楼层上添加楼板。

sents.en: The updated version adds the slab elements to the designated floors.
sents.zh: 更新后的版本在指定楼层添加了楼板构件。

paragraphs.en: This example reflects a common situation in early-stage design, where new ideas or design modifications are proposed to an already existing structure, which then need to be reflected in an updated model. By allowing for this interaction, the workflow caters to the practical needs of structural designers as they adapt their models towards the final design solution.
paragraphs.zh: 该示例反映了早期设计阶段的一种常见情况：在已有结构上提出新想法或设计修改，随后需要将这些变化反映到更新后的模型中。 通过支持这种交互，该工作流满足了结构设计师在将模型调整为最终设计方案过程中的实际需求。

sents.en: This example reflects a common situation in early-stage design, where new ideas or design modifications are proposed to an already existing structure, which then need to be reflected in an updated model.
sents.zh: 该示例反映了早期设计阶段的一种常见情况：在已有结构上提出新想法或设计修改，随后需要将这些变化反映到更新后的模型中。

sents.en: By allowing for this interaction, the workflow caters to the practical needs of structural designers as they adapt their models towards the final design solution.
sents.zh: 通过支持这种交互，该工作流满足了结构设计师在将模型调整为最终设计方案过程中的实际需求。

paragraphs.en: The example demonstrates that object-level modifications can be requested and executed on an existing model, but also reveals limitations in geometric interpretation. In Figure 3 , the agent was unable to correctly draw the slab adjacent to the initial circular footprint as requested, resulting in an unnecessary overlap between the added rectangular slab and the existing central tower slabs. Further prompt instructions or manual edits would then be needed to update this particular location as intended. Geometric errors can indeed occur due to current LLMs’ limited spatial reasoning or to ambiguity on the user prompting. This limitation highlights the need for manual inspection and verification.
paragraphs.zh: 该示例表明可以在现有模型上请求并执行对象级修改，但也揭示了几何解释方面的局限性。 在图3中，智能体未能按要求正确绘制与初始圆形基座相邻的楼板，导致新增的矩形楼板与现有的中央塔楼楼板之间出现了不必要的重叠。 随后需要进一步的提示指令或手动编辑才能按预期更新这一特定位置。 几何错误确实可能由于当前大语言模型有限的空间推理能力或用户提示中的歧义而发生。 这一局限性凸显了手动检查与验证的必要性。

sents.en: The example demonstrates that object-level modifications can be requested and executed on an existing model, but also reveals limitations in geometric interpretation.
sents.zh: 该示例表明可以在现有模型上请求并执行对象级修改，但也揭示了几何解释方面的局限性。

sents.en: In Figure 3 , the agent was unable to correctly draw the slab adjacent to the initial circular footprint as requested, resulting in an unnecessary overlap between the added rectangular slab and the existing central tower slabs.
sents.zh: 在图3中，智能体未能按要求正确绘制与初始圆形基座相邻的楼板，导致新增的矩形楼板与现有的中央塔楼楼板之间出现了不必要的重叠。

sents.en: Further prompt instructions or manual edits would then be needed to update this particular location as intended.
sents.zh: 随后需要进一步的提示指令或手动编辑才能按预期更新这一特定位置。

sents.en: Geometric errors can indeed occur due to current LLMs’ limited spatial reasoning or to ambiguity on the user prompting.
sents.zh: 几何错误确实可能由于当前大语言模型有限的空间推理能力或用户提示中的歧义而发生。

sents.en: This limitation highlights the need for manual inspection and verification.
sents.zh: 这一局限性凸显了手动检查与验证的必要性。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 presents a second sequence in which the designer deliberately starts with a simple artifact and increases its complexity over several prompts. The initial request creates two towers. A subsequent prompt connects the towers through an elevated skybridge, and a later prompt adds inclined cables to support the bridge. This sequence illustrates a different mode of use in which the user does not provide the complete design brief at once, but develops the artifact progressively. Such progressive modelling resembles early structural design practice, where designers often begin with a simple organizational idea and even generate simplified preliminary models that then become more complex over time.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 展示了另一个序列，其中设计者有意从一个简单的物件开始，并在多次提示中逐步增加其复杂度。 初始请求创建了两个塔。 随后的一个提示通过一座高架天桥将两塔连接起来，更晚的一个提示则添加倾斜的拉索来支撑该桥。 这一序列展示了另一种使用模式，即用户不是一次性提供完整的设计任务书，而是逐步发展该物件。 这种渐进式建模类似于早期的结构设计实践，设计者通常从一个简单的组织构想出发，甚至会生成简化的初步模型，然后随着时间的推移使其变得更加复杂。

sents.en: Figure 4 presents a second sequence in which the designer deliberately starts with a simple artifact and increases its complexity over several prompts.
sents.zh: 图 4 展示了另一个序列，其中设计者有意从一个简单的物件开始，并在多次提示中逐步增加其复杂度。

sents.en: The initial request creates two towers.
sents.zh: 初始请求创建了两个塔。

sents.en: A subsequent prompt connects the towers through an elevated skybridge, and a later prompt adds inclined cables to support the bridge.
sents.zh: 随后的一个提示通过一座高架天桥将两塔连接起来，更晚的一个提示则添加倾斜的拉索来支撑该桥。

sents.en: This sequence illustrates a different mode of use in which the user does not provide the complete design brief at once, but develops the artifact progressively.
sents.zh: 这一序列展示了另一种使用模式，即用户不是一次性提供完整的设计任务书，而是逐步发展该物件。

sents.en: Such progressive modelling resembles early structural design practice, where designers often begin with a simple organizational idea and even generate simplified preliminary models that then become more complex over time.
sents.zh: 这种渐进式建模类似于早期的结构设计实践，设计者通常从一个简单的组织构想出发，甚至会生成简化的初步模型，然后随着时间的推移使其变得更加复杂。

paragraphs.en: By exposing the AI agent to the model state at all times, this progressive design is possible. This example connects the current workflow to the broader idea of AI-assisted structural co-design where the AI agent is able to rapidly materialize intermediate structural artifacts, allowing the designer to inspect, revise, and redirect the model. This generation and edition of the models is a prerequisite for future structural co-design workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 通过让智能体始终能够接触模型状态，这种渐进式设计成为可能。 本示例将当前工作流与AI辅助结构协同设计的更宏观理念联系起来，其中智能体能够快速生成中间结构产物，使设计者可以检查、修改并重新引导模型。 这种模型的生成与编辑是未来结构协同设计工作流的前提条件。

sents.en: By exposing the AI agent to the model state at all times, this progressive design is possible.
sents.zh: 通过让智能体始终能够接触模型状态，这种渐进式设计成为可能。

sents.en: This example connects the current workflow to the broader idea of AI-assisted structural co-design where the AI agent is able to rapidly materialize intermediate structural artifacts, allowing the designer to inspect, revise, and redirect the model.
sents.zh: 本示例将当前工作流与AI辅助结构协同设计的更宏观理念联系起来，其中智能体能够快速生成中间结构产物，使设计者可以检查、修改并重新引导模型。

sents.en: This generation and edition of the models is a prerequisite for future structural co-design workflows.
sents.zh: 这种模型的生成与编辑是未来结构协同设计工作流的前提条件。

paragraphs.en: By reducing the effort required to create preliminary structural models and removing the friction of structural modelling, such workflows can support teams to achieve higher-performing design alternatives. The opportunities and limitations of the findings presented here are discussed in the next section.
paragraphs.zh: 通过减少创建初步结构模型所需的工作量并消除结构建模的阻力，此类工作流可以支持团队获得性能更高的设计方案。 下一节将讨论本文所述发现的机遇与局限性。

paragraphs.en: The workflow presented suggests several opportunities for early-stage structural design. First, prompt-based model generation can reduce the friction associated with repetitive model setup, allowing designers to test structural ideas more quickly. By lowering the effort required to create preliminary models, the workflow can enable greater design freedom and unlock more exploratory forms of creativity. Second, the use of explicit structural elements and access to the current state of the model using MCP servers make such that the resulting artifact can be inspected, modified and exported. Third, future AI-assisted modelling could support the design of more resource-efficient or sustainable structures by guiding the user on modifications, additions, or deletions that can have a positive outcome on the structure metrics, including material consumption and embodied carbon accounts.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出的工作流为早期结构设计提供了若干机遇。 首先，基于提示词的模型生成可以减少重复建模设置带来的摩擦，使设计人员能够更快地测试结构创意。 通过降低创建初步模型所需的投入，该工作流可以实现更大的设计自由度，并释放更多探索性的创造力。 其次，使用显式结构元素并通过 MCP 服务器访问模型的当前状态，使得生成的成果可以被检查、修改和导出。 第三，未来的 AI 辅助建模可以通过引导用户进行对结构指标（包括材料消耗和隐含碳账户）产生积极影响的修改、添加或删除，来支持设计更节约资源或更可持续的结构。

paragraphs.en: The approach may also be extended through multimodal input. Structural designers and architects do not communicate through text alone: sketches, annotations, reference images, or preliminary models are also important [ 18 ] . Future systems could therefore combine these multimodal inputs to bring human and AI understanding closer during model interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 该方法还可以通过多模态输入加以扩展。 结构设计师和建筑师的交流并不仅限于文字：草图、注释、参考图像或初步模型同样重要 [ 18 ] 。 因此，未来的系统可以结合这些多模态输入，在模型交互过程中使人类与 AI 的理解更加接近。

paragraphs.en: The current prototype also has important limitations. The examples shown in this paper are proof-of-concept rather than a formal evaluation. The generated models do not guaranty structural correctness, code compliance, or analysis readiness. Prompt ambiguity, hallucination, misinterpretation of design intent and robustness across similar prompts still needs to be assessed. Furthermore, current LLMs are known to have limited spatial reasoning [ 30 ] , such that geometric modifications can be wrongly executed by agents. The size and complexity of the models studied here are also limited. These limitations motivate the need for further research and development of benchmarks, datasets, and validation protocols for AI-assisted structural modelling.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的原型也存在重要的局限性。 本文展示的示例属于概念验证，而非正式的评估。 生成的模型不保证结构正确性、规范符合性或分析可用性。 提示词的歧义、幻觉、对设计意图的误解，以及面对相似提示词时的稳健性，仍需进一步评估。 此外，已知当前的LLM空间推理能力有限 [ 30 ]，因此几何修改可能被智能体错误执行。 此处所研究模型的规模和复杂度也较为有限。 这些局限性促使我们需要进一步开展研究，并开发面向AI辅助结构建模的基准、数据集和验证协议。

paragraphs.en: Building on existing research that formalizes structural design as an exploratory and creative discipline, this paper presented a proof-of-concept workflow to generate editable early-stage structural building models from natural-language prompts. The workflow presented combines language-agent reasoning with a COMPAS-based structural modelling API exposed through an MCP server. Through selected examples, the paper shows that language agents can create editable structural artifacts that can assist in early structural design workflows. This work argues that LLMs introduce a new design paradigm in structural design and make it possible to establish new modes of interaction between human designers and structural models. The contribution is preliminary and a series of limitations exist regarding the size of the models, analysis readiness, and the risk of intent misinterpretation. Nevertheless, the results suggest that structural design is a relevant and challenging domain for future AI-assisted modelling workflows, where the goal is not autonomous design but the reduction of friction between design intent and editable structural models towards more creative and efficient designs.
paragraphs.zh: 在现有将结构设计形式化为一门探索性与创造性学科的研究基础上，本文提出了一种概念验证工作流，可从自然语言提示生成可编辑的早期结构建筑模型。 该工作流将语言智能体推理与通过 MCP 服务器暴露的基于 COMPAS 的结构建模 API 相结合。 通过选定的示例，本文表明语言智能体能够创建可编辑的结构构件，从而协助早期结构设计工作流。 本工作认为，大语言模型为结构设计引入了一种新的设计范式，并使在人类设计师与结构模型之间建立新的交互模式成为可能。 这项贡献尚属初步阶段，在模型规模、分析就绪度以及意图误读风险等方面存在一系列局限。 尽管如此，研究结果表明，结构设计对于未来的 AI 辅助建模工作流而言是一个相关且具有挑战性的领域，其目标并非自主设计，而是减少设计意图与可编辑结构模型之间的摩擦，以实现更具创造性和更高效的设计。
